Dear Sir/ Ma’am, 
 
Subject: Audio Recordings of Earnings Conference Call with Investor(s)/Analyst(s) 
 
This is with reference to our earlier letter dated August 25, 2026 regarding Intimation of 
Earnings Conference Call with Investor(s)/Analyst(s) on September 01, 2026 to discuss 
Financial Performance for Q1 FY 2026-27.  In this regard, pursuant to the provisions of 
Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, (“Listing Regulations”) (as amended from time to time), we wish to inform the 
Exchanges that the Audio Recording of the said Con-Call is made available on the Company's 
website i.e. www.leapindia.net  
 
The Link of the Audio Recording is as follows:  
 
https://www.leapindia.net/sites/default/files/2026-
09/LEAP%20Q1FY%202027%20Earnings%20Call%20Audio.mp3 
  
We request you to kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you.  
Yours faithfully, 
For LEAP India Limited
